findings.summary: The legend draws every series with a swatch heavier than the line it names: 'cell outline' at lw=1.5 against the 0.45 pt mask outline at line 98, 'solved flux' at 2.6 against 0.9, 'EFIT flux' at 2.6 against 0.7 and 'boundary level' at 2.4 against 1.5. Measured on the rendered PNG, the solved-flux swatch is a 3 px solid bar while the drawn contours run 1-2 px, and the cell-outline swatch reads as a bold purple rule while the mask outlines are sub-pixel (their pixels average 52/255 of ink). The repository plotting rule asks for legend entries as thick as the lines, and a reader who calibrates the picture from the legend over-estimates every series, most damagingly the support mask, which is the subject of all four figures.

The attached PNGs are not provably the rendering of the reviewed head. The only recorded render in the run, render-final.log, ran at revision afda54a04 and wrote the preview PNGs at 10:26 (the attached images match those previews' dimensions). The reviewed head 12beec4a1 was committed at 10:27 and changes all four SVGs (numstat 1/1, 1/1, 2/0, 1/1) with no later render log and no newer preview. A reader therefore cannot tell that the picture reviewed here is the picture the head serves, and this review is barred from inspecting SVG content to find what changed between the two renditions.

In panels 2-4 the 10-cell support occupies about 26x22 px of a 316x468 px panel and is drawn with 0.45 pt outlines at zorder 1, beneath the solved-flux contours and the boundary level, which are stacked on the same spot. Only about 96 cell-outline pixels survive in each panel against roughly 250 that the same mask would produce from panel 1's per-cell density, the rest being overdrawn or blended away. The reader sees a pale speck near the X-point rather than the support the figure exists to show, and cannot check the caption's '10 cells' against the picture.

The 8-cell support has the same problem as the trip-3 figure and, at these weights, the two images are visually indistinguishable: 8 and 10 cells both render as an identical pale speck of about 22 and 14 surviving outline pixels respectively. The evidence fragment presents the two figures side by side as distinct states, but a reader comparing them can only find the difference in the printed counts, not in the marks.

findings_note: no finding blocks: every label is placed and readable, no text is clipped or overlapping, and each figure's central spatial claim (the support region and its position relative to the limiter and the reference field) is visible in the picture. The four recorded defects are weight, provenance and small-mask visibility, not readability of the figures themselves.
method: each figure judged only from its attached rendered PNG at 1400x721 px (100 dpi), matched to its repository path by the stage counts printed under its panels (1089/319/319/298 = frame 137; 1089/10/10/10 = 146 trip 3; 1089/8/8/8 = 146 trip 4; 1089/401/401/345 = 179 limited); ink extents, per-panel cell-outline pixel counts, line thicknesses and text placement were measured on the PNG pixels with PIL before any verdict was written; no SVG was opened, read, rendered or diffed for content
